# Search Web

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Searches the desired browser .

## Syntax

~~~~text
searchWeb(text: <#String (Allows Variables)#>, destination: <#Enumeration (WFSearchWebDestination)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
searchWeb(text: "Jellycuts", destination: Google)
~~~~
